business_problem: Renewi’s in-house monitoring software was hard to update, lacked comprehensive support, and did not give the company the visibility it needed across critical applications and operational data.
solution_summary: Renewi replaced an in-house monitoring tool with Elastic Observability running on Elastic Cloud hosted on Microsoft Azure. The new platform collects logs, metrics, traces, and availability data from multiple business-critical applications and consolidates them into configurable dashboards that both technical teams and functional managers can use. Azure provides the scalable managed cloud environment, while Elastic Cloud removes day-to-day maintenance and lets Renewi focus on application innovation rather than tooling upkeep. The implementation gives teams real-time visibility into waste-stream operations and application behavior, improves fault detection and resolution, and creates shared transparency across previously siloed systems. Renewi is also using the platform to standardize incident workflows around services such as Salesforce and ServiceNow while reducing infrastructure overhead and energy consumption compared with its previous approach.

solution_components.name: Elastic Observability
solution_components.role: Collects and visualizes logs, metrics, traces, and availability signals from Renewi’s applications.

solution_components.name: Elastic Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the managed Elastic deployment that removes routine platform maintenance work.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure
solution_components.role: Hosts the Elastic Cloud deployment on scalable cloud infrastructure aligned to Renewi’s IT strategy.

data_flow: Operational telemetry from middleware and business-critical applications is ingested into Elastic Observability on Elastic Cloud, correlated on Azure-hosted infrastructure, and then exposed through team-specific dashboards for monitoring and incident response.
business_outcome: Renewi improved observability for critical applications, accelerated fault detection, and lowered maintenance and energy overhead by moving to a managed cloud monitoring stack.
metrics: Renewi has a recycling rate of 65 percent, with a goal to reach 75 percent by 2025
architecture_clues: Elastic Observability unifies logs, metrics, traces, and availability data from multiple sources
Dedicated Elastic spaces and dashboards are created for different teams
Future incident workflows forward Elastic alerts to the right team for resolution

It quickly became clear that the Elastic Cloud deployment hosted on Microsoft Azure better aligned with Renewi’s IT strategy.
